ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; surface is approximately 95% low-intensity (black) with sparse, localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity base across entire visible ventral surface; distinct high-intensity circular clusters concentrated at distal tips and scattered randomly across both lobes; specific high-intensity linear streaks located in central and lower quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; calculated vertex angle of approximately 75 degrees; vertex depth is approximately 15% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, low-frequency irregular peaks and valleys on the left lobe trailing edge; moderate-amplitude, medium-frequency serrations along the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep on superior edges of both lobes, terminating in sharp, irregularly textured distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of circular high-contrast pixel groups on the far left distal tip; isolated circular white spots distributed across the mid-section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 3-4 parallel vertical high-intensity lines on the mid-left lobe; series of 4-5 parallel diagonal high-intensity lines on the lower-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel linear pixel disruptions (multi-track scarring) on the central and right ventral regions; high-density heterogeneous texture at distal tips consistent with localized material accumulation.
other_distinctive_markers: Single high-contrast circular annulus (ring structure) located in the upper-medial region of the left lobe.
